rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ 'A potentiometer measures current directly.' ✅ It measures *potential difference (voltage)* by finding a null point where no current flows through the galvanometer.  ·  ❌ 'A potentiometer is the same as a voltmeter.' ✅ A voltmeter draws current and has finite resistance; a potentiometer draws *zero current* at balance, giving a more accurate measurement.
